title: Olive's Rainy Day Bush
checkpoint: Year 1 Spring 2, week 1 — School readiness — Phase 5: new ways to say and spell ea, ou, ou
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations ou as u, ear as er, or as er.

pages.text: Olive wants a snug spot in the bush.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl peering into a thick, leafy hedge, looking for a good spot.

pages.text: Olive picks dry twigs from the bush.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl carefully selecting dry twigs from among the hedge branches.

pages.text: Olive picks a dry leaf too.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl gathering a bundle of dry, crisp leaves.

pages.text: Olive stacks the twigs in a gap.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl arranging twigs and a leaf into a small, neat pile tucked into a gap in the hedge.

pages.text: A gust of wind tips the pile over.
pages.illustration: A sudden gust of wind blowing the twigs and leaves apart across the ground.

pages.text: Olive sighs and picks it all up again.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl gathering up the scattered twigs and leaves once more, patient.

pages.text: This time, Olive sets a flat stone on top.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl placing a flat stone on top of the rebuilt pile to weigh it down.

pages.text: The pile stays put in the wind.
pages.illustration: The pile of twigs and leaves holding firm under the flat stone, even as wind blows past.

pages.text: Olive tucks herself into the snug spot.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl settling comfortably into the finished, snug nook in the hedge.

pages.text: Olive is ready for a rainy day.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl resting contentedly in her hedge spot as rain begins to fall outside.
